title: THESE Stocks might Get SCREWED
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.theme: Agentic AI is not a CPU boom
macro_themes.view: One 256-core AMD Venice could host ~900 agent VMs; 1B agents by 2030 needs only ~1.2M CPUs (~$5.5B revenue), a rounding error vs Nvidia data-center sales.

macro_themes.theme: Frontier compute is where the money is
macro_themes.view: Spending by Anthropic/OpenAI/xAI on frontier chips at Nvidia and AMD is the real trade; Anthropic, OpenAI and the labor market are the canaries.
Short term everything could rise on an Iran deal or fall without one.

calls.reason: Up ~183% YTD and overbought on daily and weekly; the CPU-for-agents thesis is overblown because agents need little CPU.
calls.quote: But longer term, we're probably a little overblown on CPUs.

calls.reason: Up ~214% YTD on CPU/agent enthusiasm he considers overblown.
calls.quote: I just think some of this got a little ahead of itself because I don't think we need that many CPUs.

calls.reason: Frontier-chip spending by AI labs flows to Nvidia (and AMD); that is the good trade, not agent CPUs.
calls.quote: they keep throwing it at Nvidia and AMD for frontier chips, that is a good trade

notes: No date stated; listing date used. AMD 645 is the recent high he cites ('went all the way up to 645'). Says he is not short and calls AMD a great company; bias is 'overblown/ahead of itself' rather than an explicit short.
